name: Mackerel & horse mackerels
description: Mackerel (Scomber japonicus) and horse mackerels (Trachurus trachurus, T. trecae, Caranx rhonchus) - the schooling midwater predators that dominate the industrial pelagic trawl catch. Functional group pooling the source's mackerel and horse-mackerels compartments: both are schooling carangid-grade predators feeding on zooplankton and small fish, and horse mackerels feed partly on the seafloor, so the two are pooled here to fit this atlas's 25-node ceiling. Horse mackerels import 6% of their diet from outside the modelled system, so this node's weights sum to about 0.97.
